intro: Jorgen is a discreet human informant residing in Stormwind City, tucked away by the water just inside the Valley of Heroes. Despite his modest and out-of-the-way perch, he is entangled in sensitive matters involving prominent figures in the capital, including Elling Trias and Bishop DeLavey.

p: Positioned down near the water immediately to the right of Stormwind's monumental entryway, Jorgen maintains a low profile away from the bustling thoroughfares of the city. While the towering statues of heroes overlook the bridge above, Jorgen monitors comings and goings from the shadows below, serving as a quiet contact for those who need information kept off the record.
